subject: Force legend titles over keys despite horizontal direction and box?

messages.author: 409dfe1554e9c224
messages.subject: Force legend titles over keys despite horizontal direction and box?
parts:
Hi,

Consider this.

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt))
p + geom_point(aes(shape=factor(cyl),color=qsec)) + theme(legend.position="top",legend.box="horizontal")

The legend here may be abstracted to
     Title1 Key1 Key2 ---- Title2 Key2 Key2

I'd like to achieve
     Title1              Title2
     Key1 Key2 ---- Key2 Key2

Is that currently possible?

Thanks, Joh

messages.subject: [SOLVED] Re: Force legend titles over keys despite horizontal direction and box?
parts:
On Monday, May 27, 2013 1:36:57 PM UTC+3, baptiste wrote:
Hi,

guides(colour=guide_legend(title.position="top"))

should do it.

HTH,

b.
